placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for reliability and resilience practices, specifically recovery mechanisms and rollback drill cadence.
placements.title: System reliability through continuous operational validation and resilience practices
placements.frame: How does the organization build, test, and guarantee recovery and resilience mechanisms across its systems?

placements.title: Operational rollback capabilities are real only when routinely rehearsed
placements.frame: Does the expression treat unpracticed recovery procedures as absent capability requiring mandatory scheduled rehearsal?
placements.why: Places Quinton Fairweather's directive and foundational axiom establishing that an unrehearsed rollback does not constitute real operational capability, mandating monthly rehearsals for Atlas.
